title: 26 CFR 1.731-1, Extent of recognition of gain or loss on distribution (4-1-25 edition)
issuer: U.S. Government Publishing Office, Code of Federal Regulations

passages.question: Are year-end cash draws treated as distributions on June 30, 2026 even if advanced earlier?
passages.excerpt: For the purposes of sections 731 and 705, advances or drawings of money or property against a partner's distributive share of income shall be treated as current distributions made on the last day of the partnership taxable year with respect to such partner.
